name: com.netease.yunxin.kit.smslogin.CommonBrowseActivity
description: The NetEase Yunxin SMS Login SDK opens this in-app browser for links configured on its login and registration screens, such as terms or privacy pages. It displays web pages inside the app and hands non-web links to another app when available.
disableEffect: Users cannot open configured terms, privacy, or other login-screen links through this in-app browser.
